scripts.dev: bun run install:templates && bun run app.ts
scripts.chat: bun run install:templates && bun run app.ts chat
scripts.tui: bun run install:templates && bun run app.ts tui
scripts.setup: bun run install:templates && bun run app.ts setup
scripts.status: bun run install:templates && bun run app.ts status
scripts.doctor: bun run install:templates && bun run app.ts doctor
scripts.docker:up: bun run docker:templates && bun run build:binary:docker && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
scripts.docker:dev: bun run docker:up && bun run docker:logs
scripts.docker:chat: bun run docker:up && docker exec -it flyflor-dev flyflor
scripts.test: bun test tests/activation.test.ts tests/background.scheduler.test.ts tests/blackboard.boundaries.test.ts tests/chaos.fuzz.test.ts tests/chat.boundaries.test.ts tests/command.boundaries.test.ts tests/config.view.test.ts tests/consolidation.test.ts tests/decay.anti.bloat.project.test.ts tests/dream.worker.test.ts tests/feedback.interpreter.test.ts tests/feedback.wire.test.ts tests/install.script.test.ts tests/installer.planner.test.ts tests/journal.store.test.ts tests/memory.boundaries.test.ts tests/memory.scheduler.wiring.test.ts tests/project.scaffolder.test.ts tests/reflection.boundaries.test.ts tests/route.escalation.test.ts tests/runtime.perf.test.ts tests/skill.mcp.test.ts tests/version.test.ts tests/workers.boundaries.test.ts
scripts.build:binary: bun build --compile --target=bun --packages=bundle --reject-unresolved --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_COMMIT="'$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)'" --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_TARGET="'bun'" --outfile dist/flyflor app.ts
scripts.build:binary:linux-arm64: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --packages=bundle --reject-unresolved --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_COMMIT="'$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)'" --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_TARGET="'linux-arm64'" --outfile dist/flyflor-linux-arm64 app.ts
scripts.build:binary:linux-x64: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --packages=bundle --reject-unresolved --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_COMMIT="'$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)'" --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_TARGET="'linux-x64'" --outfile dist/flyflor-linux app.ts
